answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks by making new identities expensive to mint and cheap to verify. Each entrant posts a refundable bond into a basalt-hard escrow that unlocks only after a probation window of attested work. Peers grade outcomes, not account count, so sockpuppets cannot vote themselves into rewards. A public reputation surface, polished like opal, records who paid the bond and who actually delivered. Unproven traffic stays behind a velvet rope until the bond seasons, which keeps cheap replicas from flooding consensus.
